blocks.text: New-hire pick integration guide, building 2

This is the working cut for PCF-DOC-2024-094 on August 29, 2024. Tasha Quinn asked for a written bound after the current path (Shadow 2 hours then a full wave) stopped being honest. I am Jeilen Jones, Order Picker, writing for Marcus Hale, Tasha Quinn, and Ben Crowe. Primary host huddle.pinecrest.internal. If you are skimming, jump the decision callout, then the refuse on solo wave on day one because we are short, then open questions. If you are on the floor next shift, jump the constraints, the numbers table, and the steps.

Five-day buddy. RF SOP, pick path SOP, jack pre-op. Solo wave only after a clean tote audit. I am not restating a hallway yes. solo wave on day one because we are short is out because August 6 day-one solo put 8 mispicks into pack before lunch. Cost of doing nothing is already in the numbers: days=5, miss=8, hours=2, weeks=2, sops=3, audit=1, lunch=1, solo=0. Sibling tickets PCF-2100 and PCF-SOP-2023-014. I will not reopen solo wave on day one because we are short in a side thread because someone asked for a rate waiver. Tasha Quinn is the acceptor unless the owners line says otherwise.

blocks.text: Background. Why the current path is the wrong tool

Ben Crowe owns a leftover that is easy to skip: aisle-b2.pinecrest.internal. I will ping once. After that the owner is late, not blocked. Unique to this file (19): refuse on solo wave on day one because we are short, lock is 5-day buddy, audit, then solo. I will not hide a process change inside a 'quick align' on PCF-2100.
Day one is not a wave alone. Day one is a buddy and a short list.

What a skeptical lead would try first on huddle.pinecrest.internal: the path Tasha Quinn actually has, not an empty-tote photo. Metric I will argue is a clean confirm, not a vanity units-per-hour. If we cannot show that path on rf.pinecrest.internal with the numbers already in this file, we do not have a cut. Jeilen Jones will not accept a hallway yes as that proof.
